title: The Art of Metaphor: ReFantazio Book Is Now Available To Preorder, Out Next March
take: Obsessed with Metaphor: ReFantazio? Get ready to dive even deeper into IGN’s 2024 Game of the Year because "The Art of Metaphor: ReFantazio" hardcover art book is available for preorder now! This gorgeous release, priced at $50, drops March 9, 2027, and it’s absolutely packed with behind-the-scenes details, concept art, character sketches, and insights into the game’s narrative and gameplay. Seriously, it’s already sold out at some retailers, so if you’re a superfan, snagging this stunning collection of gaming goodness now is probably a smart move!

title: The Witcher 3 Remastered Nintendo Switch 2 Can Be Unlocked for Free Even if You Borrow a Switch Physical Copy From a Friend
take: Get ready to channel your inner Geralt on the Switch 2 for absolutely free (with a friend's help)! CD Projekt Red is making good on their promise, allowing any physical copy of The Witcher 3 for the original Switch to unlock the glorious Remastered edition on the new console. This means you can borrow, rent, or even quickly buy and trade back a cartridge to permanently bag a digital copy packed with combat upgrades, a revamped skill tree, armor transmog, and tons of visual enhancements like ray tracing. Forget keeping the cartridge inserted – once unlocked, it's yours to enjoy, including both original expansions, until the paid "Songs of the Past" arrives next year. Talk about a generous way to dive into monster hunting!

title: Sony and Nintendo Should Keep the Current Gen Going for as Long as Possible 'Because People Are Very Happy Using PS5 and Switch 2,' Former PlayStation Exec Says
take: Former PlayStation boss Shuhei Yoshida is dropping some wisdom, suggesting Sony and Nintendo should keep the PS5 and Switch 2 humming along as long as possible! With console prices already soaring thanks to "RAMageddon" and manufacturing woes, it makes total sense. Gamers are happy with their current systems, and honestly, who wants to shell out a grand for a PS6 when the PS5 Pro already costs $900? Developers aren't even screaming for more power, so let's enjoy our current-gen gems for a while longer!

title: Save Up to $1,000 Off CORSAIR Prebuilt Gaming PCs With Nvidia GeForce RTX GPUs for This Week Only
take: Big news for PC gamers looking to upgrade their setup! CORSAIR is dropping some serious discounts – up to a whopping $1,000 off – on their VENGEANCE and CORSAIR ONE prebuilt gaming PCs, but only for this week. These aren't just any systems; they come packed with NVIDIA GeForce RTX 50 series GPUs and are hand-assembled with top-tier, non-proprietary components, meaning future upgrades are a breeze. If you've been eyeing a beast like the VENGEANCE a7500 with its RTX 5080 and Ryzen 7 9800X3D, now’s your moment to snag a deal and dive into those high-fidelity browser games!

title: Corsair Gaming Headsets See Early Prime Big Deal Days Discounts on Amazon UK
take: Thinking about upgrading your audio setup for those intense gaming sessions? You're in luck! Amazon UK is dropping some sweet early deals on Corsair gaming headsets even before Prime Big Deal Days officially starts. The Corsair VOID v2 wireless headset, a real looker with its earcup lighting and Dolby Atmos, is rocking a 30% discount at £69.99. With 70-hour battery life and multi-platform support (PC, PlayStation, Switch, mobile!), it's perfect for tracking every enemy footstep in Dead by Daylight or keeping tabs on proximity chat in ARC Raiders. Don't sleep on these pre-Prime deals if you're chasing that competitive edge!

title: Minecraft LIVE September 2026 Live Report — All the News as It Happens
take: Minecraft LIVE just dropped a treasure chest of news, and we're buzzing! Mojang promised "game drops" and "behind-the-scenes secrets," and they delivered, even if the Minecraft Dungeons 2 reveal was expected with its September 29th launch. But the real game-changer? That blink-and-you'll-miss-it Eye of Ender and Enderman in the trailer has fans hoping for a massive End update. Considering the End dimension hasn't had a proper refresh since 2016, this would be HUGE for the best-selling game of all time. We're talking a megaton of new gameplay for all you explorers out there!

title: PlayStation Reportedly Polling Game Developers After Decision to Kill Discs Sparks Backlash
take: Looks like PlayStation might be feeling the heat after their decision to ditch physical game discs! Rumors are swirling that Sony is now sending out super-long surveys to game developers, slyly asking for feedback on how they sell physical games. Fans and devs alike have been vocal about their displeasure, and it seems even the mightiest console maker can't ignore a good old-fashioned outcry. While execs still talk an all-digital future, this survey suggests they might be reconsidering if enough developers speak up. Could this be a small win for disc collectors everywhere? We can hope!

title: The 4K-Ready MSI Codex Z2 GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Gaming PC Drops to $1,699 After a $600 Discount
take: Looking to dive into glorious 4K gaming without selling a kidney? Walmart just dropped a jaw-dropping deal on the MSI Codex Z2 gaming PC, slashed by $600 to a sweet $1,699! This bad boy packs an RTX 5070 Ti, which is a total beast for crushing games like Death Stranding 2 and Crimson Desert at 60+fps in 4K – no sweat. Plus, that 5070 Ti alone usually costs almost a grand, so grabbing this whole prebuilt rig is basically a steal and the only way to get your hands on this powerful Blackwell card without a huge markup. If you've been dreaming of ultra-crisp, smooth visuals, now's your chance!

title: Scrapped GTA 5 Story DLC Might Have Taken the Series Overseas for the First Time in 15 Years
take: Ever wonder what became of GTA 5's lost story DLC? Well, new leaks reveal that Rockstar almost took players to Paris – a first for the series in 15 years! Imagine Trevor as a secret agent, jet-setting to a swanky Parisian apartment overlooking the Eiffel Tower. While it seems the overseas adventure might have been limited to a killer cutscene or assassination, it’s a peek at how close we were to a truly global Grand Theft Auto. Sadly, Red Dead Redemption 2 and GTA Online’s massive success ultimately sidelined this cool concept, proving that even awesome ideas sometimes get cancelled for bigger fish.

title: Microsoft Signals Intention to Close Down Ninja Theory After Deals to Save the Hellblade Developer Fall Through
take: Talk about a plot twist! It seems Ninja Theory, the brilliant minds behind the *Hellblade* series, are facing the ultimate boss battle: closure. Microsoft has signaled its intent to shut down the studio after two deals to save them fell through, which is absolutely wild given they just announced *Senua*, the third *Hellblade* game, a few months ago. We're talking serious whiplash for fans and the studio alike! While Microsoft says they're still open to a last-minute rescue, and we've seen studios like Double Fine and Compulsion go independent with their IP, it's a grim outlook for Senua's future. Our fingers are crossed for a miracle – we need more of that unique *Hellblade* magic!

title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 Is Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 – Here’s Where You Can Preorder It
take: Whoa, big news for medieval RPG fans with Nintendo Switch 2 on their radar! Kingdom Come: Deliverance 2 is officially heading to the new console next year, and it's even a Royal Edition. This is a huge win for those who love deep, historical adventures and were worried about missing out on the sequel without a high-end PC or other console. While the exact release date is still a mystery, you can already lock in your preorder at Amazon – grab it for $59.99 and be ready to dive into 15th-century Bohemia on the go!

title: Hideo Kojima Reveals What Happened With Sony in Exclusive First Interview Since PlayStation Ditched Physint
take: Whoa, talk about a plot twist! Hideo Kojima just spilled the tea on what really went down with Sony and Physint. Apparently, PlayStation pulled the plug on funding for the Metal Gear Solid spiritual successor, leaving Kojima stunned and worried for his studio’s future. But fear not, gamers, because Xbox swooped in to save the day, snatching up Physint in what’s being called one of the wildest console switches ever. Looks like we might be playing this one on Xbox after all!

title: As Fans Flood the World of Warcraft: Forever Beta, Dev Says It's Putting Up 'The Craziest Numbers I've Seen in 17 Years Working at Blizzard'
take: World of Warcraft: Forever’s beta is absolutely blowing up, surprising even Blizzard! Turns out, a "Classic Plus" take on WoW's early days is exactly what players craved, with one dev calling the beta numbers "the craziest" he's seen in 17 years. While the initial flood caused some major lag and disconnects (classic beta problems, right?), Blizzard quickly smoothed things out. Now, players are raving about the updated visuals and sound, making this nostalgic trip feel fresh. Looks like November 4th can't come soon enough for this runaway hit!

title: Get a Free $10 Nintendo eShop eGift Card When You Purchase a $70 One at Newegg
take: Gamers looking to boost their Nintendo eShop credit should absolutely jump on Newegg’s sweet new deal! Right now, buying a $70 eShop gift card gets you a bonus $10 eGift card free – that’s an extra game or DLC just for buying what you might already need. With Nintendo’s Customer Appreciation Sale still going strong until September 26th, full of fantastic discounts on titles like Metroid Dread and Super Mario Galaxy, this bonus credit is practically begging to be spent. Both cards are email-delivered, so it's super convenient, but don’t wait too long – this offer is only available while supplies last!

title: The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless Gaming Headset With Infinite Battery Life Drops to a New Low
take: Attention, console and PC players! The legendary SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro wireless gaming headset just hit its lowest price ever, and this is a deal you absolutely shouldn't miss. Famous for its ingenious hot-swappable battery system, you'll get virtually infinite playtime without ever needing to plug in your headset mid-game – seriously, zero downtime. Even though a successor exists, the Nova Pro still delivers a "Masterpiece" 10/10 experience with fantastic spatial sound and a super clear mic, making this a stellar pick for any serious gamer.

title: MindsEye Developers Say They've Been Laid Off Amid Questions Over Build a Rocket Boy's Future
take: Woah, talk about a rocky road for Build A Rocket Boy! MindsEye, the big action-adventure game from the former Grand Theft Auto design chief, is taking a serious hit as developers confirm layoffs. This comes after the game, originally part of a 'Roblox for adults' platform called Everywhere, absolutely tanked at launch last year, with players calling it "broken" and "the worst game of 2025." Despite patches and even a "Blacklisted" update, MindsEye just couldn't find its footing, hitting a measly 16 concurrent players on Steam. It’s a sad lesson in how even big names and huge investments can’t guarantee a hit game without a solid launch!

title: Fable Developer Explains Why Xbox 'Protected' the Project Over Its Long Development Cycle, Amid Layoffs and Studio Closures Elsewhere
take: Ever wonder how some games survive epic development cycles while others bite the dust? Playground Games' upcoming Fable has been in the oven for a whopping ten years, weathering countless Xbox studio closures and mass layoffs. Director Ralph Fulton says it’s because Fable is "vital" to Xbox's DNA and offers a unique combination of elements found nowhere else. It's awesome to see a beloved franchise get the protection it needs, especially when another Playground team was simultaneously crushing it with the Forza Horizon series! Get ready to explore Albion again when Fable finally launches on February 23, 2027!

title: Discover Your Next Must-Play PC Game With Steam Hype
take: Finding your next PC obsession just got a whole lot easier with the launch of Steam Hype! This new website is a godsend for anyone overwhelmed by the sheer number of games hitting Steam daily. Forget faceless algorithms; Steam Hype boasts real human experts ready to hand-pick the best, from hyped releases to obscure indies and even those gems that got better post-launch. With deep dives into RPGs, retro FPS, and exclusive PC titles, it’s the ultimate guide to navigating the colossal world of PC gaming.

title: StarCraft Devs Promise New Game Will Definitely Release in 2030
take: Well, this is certainly a spicy one for the StarCraft faithful! Blizzard just dropped a bombshell, announcing a new StarCraft game—but wait, it’s an open-world shooter, not an RTS, and it's not landing until 2030. That's a brave, some might say audacious, move to transform such a beloved sci-fi strategy series into a shooter and then give us a release date that’s practically a decade away. Developers say this firm 2030 target keeps them "honest," acting as a rallying cry, which sounds like they're really aiming for something massive and authentic that both veterans and newcomers will love. Here's hoping it's worth the wait when we finally get to go boots-on-the-ground against a terrifying 10-foot Hydralisk!

title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World Has 500 Beasts to Collect, and They're All Super Weird | IGN Preview
take: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World is shaping up to be a gloriously bizarre monster-collecting adventure! With a whopping 500 unique monsters designed by the legendary Akira Toriyama, fans of the long-running series will have their hands full, especially since you can even roll with an all-Slime party if you want. Plus, returning protagonists Bianca and Nera from Dragon Quest V aren't just along for the ride; their unique perks and preferred monster types add a cool strategic layer to building your ultimate team. Get ready to dive into some charming, high-fantasy weirdness!

title: A Whisper of Fall: Jinyiwei Brings Serious Martial-Arts Spectacle to Soulslikes | IGN Preview
take: A Whisper of Fall: Jinyiwei is set to bring some seriously slick martial-arts action to the Soulslike genre! This upcoming action-RPG blends intense wuxia-inspired combat, reminiscent of Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon, with parkour-style action-platforming that'll make Assassin's Creed fans feel right at home. You’ll be playing as a Ming Dynasty imperial agent, taking down threats with graceful wall-runs and air-streaking attacks, all while building internal energy for critical strikes. It sounds like a visually exciting, less fantastical take on the Chinese-mythology action-RPG, and we can't wait to see if it delivers on that promise of stylish, skillful combat!

title: Grand Theft Auto VI Limited-Edition PS5 DualSense Controllers Are Up for Preorder
take: Get ready to cruise through Vice City in style because limited-edition Grand Theft Auto VI PS5 DualSense controllers are up for grabs! Sony and Rockstar are dropping two sleek designs, one black and one white, both sporting a subtle "VI" on the touchpad and cool palm tree etchings. That black version is a PlayStation Direct exclusive, so if you want to capture that Vice City nightlife vibe, you better jump on it fast because these beauties, with their color-shifting grips and all the usual DualSense perks, are sure to sell out quicker than you can say "wasted."

title: Resident Evil 2, 3, and 4 Remakes Are Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 Very Soon
take: Horror hounds, get ready to scream on the go! Capcom is bringing the fantastic Resident Evil 2, 3, and 4 remakes to the Nintendo Switch 2 next month, dropping digitally on October 16th. This means you can finally experience these modern classics – complete with all their DLC, including Ada Wong's Separate Ways – wherever your spooky heart desires. While no wild new features are announced, having nearly the entire numbered Resident Evil saga natively playable on the Switch 2 is a massive win for fans and portable gaming alike. Plus, the upcoming Resident Evil Veronica remake is also slated for the console, keeping the fear train rolling!

title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Release Date Confirmed, and It Looks Like a Faithful-Looking Return With a Few Surprises
take: Get ready to revisit Hyrule, because The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is getting a full remake for the Switch 2, hitting shelves November 5! Nintendo is bravely dropping this N64 classic in the same month as GTA 6, proving they truly believe in Link’s legendary adventure. Expect a stunning new 3D look, modern upgrades like manual jumping and motion controls, and even fully voiced cutscenes (though Link's still the strong, silent type). Plus, you can hum Ocarina songs instead of just mashing buttons and grab a real Ocarina accessory! This faithful remake, with its Threads of Time quest log and new minigame areas, is shaping up to be a truly epic return.

title: The Secretlab Labor Day Sale Has Big Discounts on Its Titan Gaming Chairs Including the Nanogen Edition
take: Gamers, if you're still rocking that rickety kitchen chair during your epic play sessions, Secretlab's Labor Day Sale is calling your name! Their highly-rated Titan Evo gaming chairs, beloved by pros and casual players alike, are seeing some sweet discounts. Not only can you grab the standard versions, but fantastic licensed designs for games like Genshin Impact and anime like Jujutsu Kaisen are also included. Even the super-luxe Nanogen Edition, rarely on sale, is getting a price cut – perfect for leveling up your comfort and crushing those high scores!

title: Exodus Ending and Character Fates Change Based on Your Choices
take: Archetype Entertainment’s upcoming RPG, Exodus, is shaping up to be a true player-choice powerhouse, confirming that your decisions will dramatically alter character fates and even the game's ending! Narrative director Drew Karpyshyn, a Mass Effect legend, revealed that companions might not stick with you if your choices rub them the wrong way, potentially leading to their departure or even impacting their survival. Forget simple morality systems; this sounds like deep, evolving relationships and branching storylines where every choice truly matters, even in optional content. Get ready for some serious re-playability when Exodus drops on April 7, 2027, for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC!

title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis Could Be Great, But There's Some Things We Can't Ignore...
take: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is blowing us away with its absolutely gorgeous visuals, making those old pointy polygons a distant memory! The new Damocles Room, famed for its raining swords, looks incredible and preserves that classic "tiny human in a giant tomb" feeling, amplified by next-gen graphics. However, while director Raul Siqueira talks about knowing what to change, the new "helpful" swords and a surprising lack of self-awareness might leave some fans scratching their heads. This "unified timeline" game is trying to bridge a lot of Lara's different eras, and we're curious to see how that tonal blend plays out when we finally get our hands on it!

title: White House Launches Arcade.Gov, a Minigame Site Where You Catch Immigrants, Build a Tetris Border Wall, and 'Fill Your Kids' Trump Accounts' With Bitcoin
take: The White House just dropped Arcade.Gov, a new mini-game site that's certainly… something! Featuring titles like "Rio Run" (a Snake-like game where you round up "crossers") and "Build the Wall: Zombie Border Siege" (a Tetris clone with green aliens), these games offer a uniquely political spin on classic gameplay. It’s wild to see familiar game mechanics twisted into something so provocative, especially with parody console startup animations. And with Nintendo already calling out the regime for IP infringement, this site is definitely stirring up a storm!

title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Is Getting a Pair of Limited Edition PS5 Controllers
take: Well, hello there, gorgeous! Grand Theft Auto 6 is gearing up for its big November 19 launch, and PlayStation is definitely making sure you know where to play it best. They just dropped news of two slick, limited-edition GTA 6 PS5 controllers, boasting the iconic VI logo, palm tree etchings, and a snazzy neon purple trim. While these beauties will set you back $84.99 and likely sell out faster than a Vice City street race, they’re a cool way to show your love for the game and get those DualSense features ready. Rockstar and PlayStation are really hyping up the PS5 experience, promising exclusive features and full use of the controller's tech.

title: The Humble Choice September 2026 Lineup Is Live With Frostpunk 2, Sonic X Shadow Generations, and 6 More Games
take: September’s Humble Choice lineup just dropped, and gamers, you won't want to miss this! For a sweet $14.99, you can snag eight awesome PC games for your Steam library, including the highly-anticipated Frostpunk 2 and the lightning-fast Sonic X Shadow Generations. IGN gave Frostpunk 2 an 8/10 for its complex new scale, and Sonic X Shadow Generations earned a stellar 9/10, praised for doubling its campaign length with creative levels and a graphical upgrade. This isn't just a steal; it's a super-boost for your game collection!
